purpose: G5.8's eight protective statements, each keyed by the stable anchor id the brief requires. scripts/legal-placeholder-gate.ts checks by id, not by prose, exactly as the brief specifies: a statement recorded as present must still carry its anchor, and one recorded as absent must still be absent. Adding a missing clause therefore fails this gate until the record is updated, which is the point.
scope: The terms page, by anchor id. The brief also requires these statements on each consent document shown at the activation point; that surface is measured, not asserted by id, in `consentDocuments` below: a signed body carries no anchor.
browserAssertion: e2e/legal.spec.ts reads this record in a browser: every statement recorded present renders under its anchor id with a heading and a body on /terms, and every statement recorded absent renders no such anchor. Both directions, as the gate holds the source.
notDrafted: The absent clauses are not written by this repository's tooling. Drafting an indemnity, a reproductive no-reliance statement or a governing-law forum is legal work, not engineering work.

statements.requirement: Uploader warranty: at least 18 and holds the subject's documented permission
Uploader indemnity for claims arising from third-party and embryo uploads
statements.note: No indemnity language anywhere on the page. This is the case the brief names as the one that passes every other gate while leaving the operator unprotected.

statements.requirement: No medical advice and no diagnosis

statements.note: No reproductive, IVF, family-planning or conception wording on the page, despite Embryo Analysis being a shipped surface.

statements.requirement: Accuracy and completeness disclaimer covering data Inherit did not generate
statements.note: Accuracy and completeness are both disclaimed. The qualifier the brief asks for — that it covers data Inherit did not generate, which is every uploaded file — is not there. Recorded rather than gated, because the brief says to match by id and not by prose.
Governing law is stated; no forum, venue or exclusive-jurisdiction wording appears. Same reason for recording rather than gating.

statements.requirement: Inherit sells nothing and takes no payment for sequencing
statements.note: The page says Inherit will not sell the user's data, which is a different promise. Nothing states that Inherit sells nothing and takes no payment for sequencing. G5.7 proves no fee path exists in code; this is the statement of it that the terms owe the reader.

consentDocuments.method: A keyword screen (scripts/consent-statement-screen.ts) over the body_markdown of every consent artifact the migrations seed, at the latest version of each key. A body with no keyword for a class cannot carry that statement; a body with a keyword is a candidate, and `reading` says what a person found the words to be about — present, present-incomplete or not the statement. scripts/consent-statement-screen.test.ts holds this record to the migrations in both directions: every seeded document at its current version, every candidate read, every quoted `words` still in the body. No consent document carries an anchor id, so nothing here is asserted by id; a signed body is immutable and closing the gap is a new version of each document, written by counsel.
